newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Alaska Air upgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Alaska Air upgraded.

text.p: - Pacific Crest Securities upgraded Alaska Air Group Inc to buy from outperform based on better-than-expected yields and traffic, analyst Bill Whitlow said in a brief report.

- Whitlow said management was comfortable with his estimate the airline company would break even in the current first quarter, compared with a loss of $0.52 a share last year. On average analysts expect Alaska Air to lose $0.40 a share in the current quarter, according to IBES.
- Whitlow estimated 1997 earnings of "at least" $2.75, compared with $2.05 in 1996, and he set a price target above 30. Alaska Air was up 5/8 at 23-7/8.
